about.title: About the Community Atlas
about.lead: One map for the Bitcoin community, built from open sources and refreshed automatically.

sources.merchants: Places accepting bitcoin: BTC Map, from OpenStreetMap. Details are fetched live from BTC Map when you open a place.
sources.communities: Communities: the community directory of BTC Map, with their public channels only.
sources.meetup: Meetups: the public Meetup.com calendars of BTC Map communities. Placed at the community's city.
sources.planb: Conferences, meetups and workshops: the open event list of Plan ₿ Network.
sources.feeds: Community sites that publish their events in the Atlas format
sources.ecosystem: Companies: a Bitcoin-only selection made by the editors of this edition.
sources.curated: Events published by the editors of this edition.
sources.luma: Luma calendars of Bitcoin venues and communities, with their exact place.
sources.nostr: Calendar events published on Nostr (NIP-52) with the #bitcoin or #btc tag.

contribute.merchants: A place is missing or wrong: edit it on BTC Map, the atlas follows.
contribute.communities: Your community is missing: add it to BTC Map communities, with a link to your website or Meetup group.
contribute.events: Your events are missing: publish them on {channels}.
contribute.eventsFeed: To have a JSON feed read by this atlas, open the issue “Add our events” on GitHub.
contribute.ecosystem: A company should be added or removed: open the issue “Ecosystem” on GitHub, with a source.

about.fork: The Community Atlas is free software (MIT). Fork it and edit one profile folder to publish an atlas for your city, country or region, with your own name, colours and events. You can also embed this one.

licences.osm: Places and communities: © OpenStreetMap contributors and BTC Map, ODbL.
licences.meetup: Meetup events are linked, not copied: titles and times only.
licences.brands: Names and logos belong to their owners.
licences.luma: Luma events are linked, not copied: titles, times and places only.
licences.nostr: Nostr events are public notes signed by their authors.

channels.meetup: Meetup (with your group linked from your BTC Map community)
channels.feeds: a JSON feed on your own site
channels.luma: Luma (open the issue “Add our events” with your calendar)
channels.nostr: Nostr, as a calendar event (NIP-52) tagged #bitcoin

zoneHint: The meetup is somewhere in this community's area.
searchMap: Search a city, community or place
